data.title: D · 梳妆镜前的白丝晨袍独语
data.description: 安全屋静谧的卧室梳妆台前，柔和的暖黄灯光照亮了铜镜。D身着一袭纯白的真丝半透睡袍坐在软凳上，系带松松垮垮地挽着，露出精致优美的锁骨与如凝脂般的雪肌。她手持木梳慢慢梳理着长发，暗杀者的戒备在此刻完全消融，从镜子里望见你的身影，红唇边漾开只对你展现的深情浅笑。
data.action: seated at vanity table in sheer white silk peignoir robe, loosely tied collar, combing long brown hair, looking into mirror with gentle affectionate blush
data.location: cozy private bedroom vanity corner in soft amber light
data.lighting: warm intimate vanity lamps casting golden highlights on white silk and pale skin
data.mood: unguarded wifely intimacy, pure tender sanctuary
data.promptProse: Seated at an intimate vanity table in warm lamplight, D wears a sheer white silk peignoir loosely draped over bare shoulders. She gently combs her long brown hair, meeting your gaze in the mirror with quiet, loving warmth.
data.animaCaption: D sitting at a vanity table in a sheer white silk peignoir combing her hair with a warm smile.
